notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Izzet Chronarch.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {6}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Repeat.
